title: DPPH Radical Scavenging Capacity Measurement
author: Jing Xu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jiqckdw

steps.title: Prepare extract stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried extracts in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) to obtain a stock solution at a concentration of 10 mg/mL.

steps.title: Prepare DPPH radical solution
steps.instruction: Make a 120 µM DPPH radical solution using 95 % ethanol as the solvent.

steps.title: Create two‑fold dilutions in plate
steps.instruction: Using the two‑times dilution method, prepare a series of extract dilutions directly in a 96‑well microtitre plate.

steps.title: Add extract and DPPH to wells
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of each diluted extract to a well and then add 195 µL of the ethanolic DPPH solution to the same well.

steps.title: Incubate reaction mixtures
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at room temperature for 30 minutes in the dark.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Read the absorbance of each well at 517 nm using a microplate reader.

steps.title: Calculate scavenging activity
steps.instruction: Calculate the percent radical scavenging activity (%RSA) using the formula: %RSA = [(Ablank – Asample) / Ablank] × 100%, where Ablank is the absorbance of the blank (no sample) and Asample is the absorbance of the test sample. Report the mean of triplicate measurements.
